mapInfo.title: Border Ranges National Park
mapInfo.method: Terrain interpolated from cached public NSW elevation contours. Named areas and track topology use the existing NL Border Ranges schematic. Feature positions are conceptual, not surveyed or georeferenced.

buildSequence.title: 1 · The terrain
buildSequence.description: Begin with the contour-derived landscape and the Totems that identify its areas.

buildSequence.title: 2 · Define areas
buildSequence.description: Give each part of the project its own area and point of reference.

buildSequence.title: 3 · Connect paths
buildSequence.description: Connect the areas with paths so visitors can follow the project through the landscape.

buildSequence.title: 4 · Add destinations
buildSequence.description: Add learning stops and destinations as the project develops. These markers demonstrate the connections, not surveyed locations.

terrain.method: Existing NL inverse-distance contour interpolation; display height normalised and exaggerated; not a DEM. Outside the source rectangle, the circular display rim extrapolates surrounding samples.
